decisions.concise_rationale: No authoritative candidate list was supplied; the payload defines a broad discovery target.

decisions.decision: Create a 25-vehicle universe spanning gas, hybrid, PHEV, EV, mainstream and near-luxury options
decisions.reversal_conditions: Change candidate target or body-style scope.

decisions.decision: Deep-research Sienna, Telluride, Pilot, Explorer, Pathfinder and EV9
decisions.concise_rationale: All are plausible under the gate and collectively test minivan, gas-SUV, value, safety and EV hypotheses.
decisions.reversal_conditions: A deep candidate fails or a reserve produces stronger verified eligibility evidence.

decisions.concise_rationale: No complete row-3 LATCH position under the configured definition.
decisions.reversal_conditions: Authoritative exact-year anchor map shows lower anchors and tether at one row-3 seating position.

decisions.decision: Use current normalized used acquisition price for official price scoring
decisions.concise_rationale: Used-only override is more specific than the base new-MSRP language.
decisions.reversal_conditions: Scoring configuration is revised to explicitly mandate original MSRP for used vehicles.

decisions.decision: Keep MANUAL_RESEARCH.md unopened until recommendation lock
decisions.concise_rationale: Prevents anchoring and preserves an independent comparison artifact.

decisions.decision: Rank eligible planning configurations by the frozen 100-point model
decisions.concise_rationale: Code-calculated component scores were validated against category maximums and the 100-point total.
decisions.reversal_conditions: Verified input claim, price record or scoring configuration changes.

decisions.decision: Advance the top three deterministic configurations while retaining the fourth-ranked live alternate
decisions.concise_rationale: Top official scores define the slate; the alternate is retained because conditional VIN/build gates can disqualify a finalist.
decisions.reversal_conditions: A finalist fails a purchase gate or updated evidence changes the score ordering.

decisions.decision: Lock 2024 Kia EV9 Land AWD (post-Jan. 2024 build) as the provisional evidence-based recommendation
decisions.concise_rationale: It has the highest deterministic score, subject to explicit high-risk reliability and VIN/build conditions.
decisions.reversal_conditions: The recommended EV9 fails any build-date, campaign, service-history, battery-health, charging, insurance or physical-fit gate.; A Telluride with all recalls closed and clean electrical history is available within the verified market range while the EV9 cannot clear its risk gates.; The family prioritizes mature-platform dependability over efficiency strongly enough to adopt the risk-averse exploratory preset.; The Sienna's physical packaging advantage proves decisive and its updated moderate-overlap result is acceptable to the family.; A Q4 2026 transaction-price change materially alters purchase-price and TCO scores beyond the modeled ranges.

decisions.decision: Open and compare MANUAL_RESEARCH.md only after independent recommendation lock
decisions.concise_rationale: The comparison identified useful human observations and three material input errors without contaminating the locked result.
